steps.title: Worksheet 13 clevis bracket: extrude the base
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as ws13_clevis.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Draw a rectangle 26 by 60.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 clevis bracket: extrude the two sides
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane (the end). Draw the trapezium: 60 at the base, 20 at the top, 35 high.
Finish Sketch. Extrude the left side 4 thick and the right side 3 thick, Join. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 clevis bracket: boss 24 diameter
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the outside face of the left side. Draw a circle 24 diameter, 22 up and central.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Distance 4, Join. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 clevis bracket: M12 thread and 12 hole
actions: Hole: Concentric with the boss, Tapped hole, M12 x 1.75, through the boss and the left side.
Hole: in line, on the right side, Simple hole, diameter 12, Through. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 clevis bracket: two countersunk holes 6 diameter
actions: Hole: Placement = on the base, 13 from the side and 9 from each end (42 apart). Countersink, diameter 6, countersink 2 x 45 degrees, Through All. OK. Save.
steps.note: The boss height (22) and its 4 projection are scaled from the worksheet drawing. The tapped hole is modelled at the tap drill size (10.2) with an M12 cosmetic thread, as Inventor does.
